item.title: Keaton Wagler breaks Illini freshman scoring record
item.description: CHAMPAIGN, Ill. (WCIA) -- Keaton Wagler is officially the highest-scoring freshman in Illinois program history. With a bucket in the second half against UCLA, Wagler reached 495 career points, passing the record of 494 points set by Cory Bradford in 1999 and tied by Kasparas Jakucionis last season.
